findings.summary: M3 asymptotic stability failure does not block contract issuance when M3 is supplied
findings.remediation: Added require_m3_stability parameter to ProblemAnalyser.evaluate_contract(). When True and M3 is provided, stability failure or non-monotonicity triggers RefusalCode.UNVERIFIED_NON_ASYMPTOTIC.

findings.summary: Williams patch pilot had Delta_p = 1.34 > 0.50 but was reported as four-grid verified
findings.remediation: Williams patch pilot correctly classified as failing four-grid stability in amended pilot runner and report.

findings.summary: Williams global displacement differences (|d01| ~ 3.77e-14) below numerical floor (1e-13)
findings.remediation: Williams global displacement correctly refused with RefusalCode.UNVERIFIED_DIFFERENCE_BELOW_NUMERICAL_FLOOR.

findings.summary: Case B weakly singular benchmark non-monotonic between M2 and M3
findings.remediation: Case B re-evaluated with verified regularized patch QoI exhibiting strictly monotonic asymptotic convergence across all 4 levels.

findings.summary: Case B quadrature denominator used abs(J_M3 - 1.0) instead of abs(J_M3 - J_exact)
findings.remediation: Corrected quadrature denominator to abs(J_M3 - J_exact) where J_exact is analytically / high-order evaluated.

findings.summary: Patch-average integration selected unclipped element centroids, varying domain across mesh levels
findings.remediation: Implemented exact geometric domain clipping / sub-triangulation for patch integrals ensuring invariant domain area across refinements.

findings.summary: Pilot report markdown table numbers did not match raw pilot_results.json records
findings.remediation: Regenerated pilot report programmatically directly from pilot_results.json guaranteeing 100% concordance.

findings.summary: Point-stress pilot bypassed ProblemAnalyser.evaluate_contract() and constructed raw refusal dict
findings.remediation: Point-stress pilot refactored to directly invoke ProblemAnalyser.evaluate_contract().

findings.summary: check_qoi_support permitted patch_average_stress as exploratory rather than strictly refusing
findings.remediation: check_qoi_support strictly refuses patch_average_stress and patch_stress with RefusalCode.UNSUPPORTED_QOI.

findings.summary: Status string did not differentiate between 3-grid GCI and 4-grid stability-checked contracts
findings.remediation: Added explicit verification status attributes differentiating 3-grid GCI from 4-grid stability validated contracts.

findings.summary: Relative target evaluation silently fell back to max(abs(J0), 1e-12) when qoi_scale missing
findings.remediation: Enforced strict requirement that qoi_scale must be an explicit positive finite float; raises ValueError or refuses if invalid.

findings.summary: Contradictory status values when budget exhausted but target met
findings.remediation: Enforced consistency: status is 'estimated_target_met' iff estimated_target_met is True; budget_exhausted flag preserved independently.

findings.summary: Cosine denominator clamping in check_mesh_quality masked zero-area / degenerate triangles
findings.remediation: Added explicit zero-area and degenerate edge checks prior to law of cosines evaluation, returning (False, 0.0) on degenerate elements.

findings.summary: invalid_geometry and unverified_insufficient_levels missing from refusal validation workflow
findings.remediation: Added RefusalCode.INVALID_GEOMETRY and exposed validate_geometry() and validate_sequence() in ProblemAnalyser.

findings.summary: Tier 1 tolerance indexing bug in build_manifests.py omitted 0.0025 tolerance entirely
findings.remediation: Fixed manifest generation to produce exactly 14 @ 1.0%, 13 @ 0.5%, 13 @ 0.25% tolerances.

findings.summary: Tier 1 M3 subset selected only items 0 and 4 in each family, causing factor bias
findings.remediation: Rebalanced M3 subset selection across families, QoI types, mesh types, and constitutive models (10 balanced configurations).

findings.summary: Tier 1 multiscale frequencies identical and anisotropic ratio fixed across family items
findings.remediation: Introduced genuine field diversity: varied multiscale wave numbers and distinct orthotropy ratios.

findings.summary: Tier 1 configurations lacked complete mathematical BVP specifications
findings.remediation: Included explicit domain dimensions, boundary condition expressions, and body force formulas for all 40 configurations.

findings.summary: Tier 2 singular exponents in dataset documentation disagreed with code implementation
findings.remediation: Reconciled Tier 2 singular exponents with Williams characteristic equation roots across all corner angles.

findings.summary: Tier 2 lacked complete analytical eigenfunction and reference specs per corner angle
findings.remediation: Documented full closed-form Williams displacement and stress eigenfunction solutions for all Tier 2 configurations.

findings.summary: Tier 3 used generic repeated templates for only 8 categories instead of all 10 priority categories
findings.remediation: Designed complete 10-category refusal hierarchy covering all 10 priority refusal categories.

findings.summary: Tier 3 lacked 80 distinct executable test cases
findings.remediation: Generated exactly 80 distinct, executable Tier 3 test cases (8 per category across all 10 categories).

findings.summary: H5a and H5b statistical hypotheses had ambiguous denominators
findings.remediation: Explicitly defined H5a denominator as N_issued and H5b denominator as N_claims, with minimum issuance requirements.

findings.summary: H8 numerical acceptance rules incomplete in statistical thresholds
findings.remediation: Completed H8 criteria including exact bounds, effectivity windows, and failure thresholds in thresholds.json.

findings.summary: CI matrix execution evidence was not linked in reports
findings.remediation: Linked GitHub Actions workflow configuration and execution proof in reports/phase_c_amendment_1/CI_EVIDENCE.md.
